edu.desc: Thesis: Water balance of beech stands on sandy soils

exp.desc:
- Project on soil moisture and drought stress in beech forests
- Teaching: field methods seminar
- Supervising three MSc theses

pubs.role: Hartmann, N.; Petersen, J.: Soil moisture under beech in drought years
Hartmann, N. et al.: Low-cost sensors for long-term forest monitoring

cl.p1: In beech forests on sandy soils, one dry summer often decides how a stand will be doing ten years later. This has been my subject since my PhD, and the data from three drought years are now analysed.
cl.p2: With the research group I would extend these measurements to mixed stands and combine them with remote sensing. We built the sensor system ourselves and described it in a paper; it costs about a tenth of commercial systems.
cl.p3: I have supervised three MSc theses and teach a field methods seminar. A plan for the first three years is enclosed.
